youtube_title: Burnt Your Hand: Ice and Toothpaste or Cool Running Water? Brave vs Normal #24 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL #24. You burn your hand making chai. Brave rubs ice and toothpaste, Normal holds it under cool running water. Who's right? Comment B or N!
Answer: Normal. Cool the burn under cool running water for at least 20 minutes. Toothpaste and butter don't cool a burn, and no ice either. Then cover it loosely with cling film. Big burn or on the face? See a doctor.
Source: British Red Cross burns first aid; NHS burns and scalds treatment.
